module: Core of the career delivery (logistics) system: delivery game clock, saving/loading of logisticsDatabase.json (parcels, vehicle offers, facilities, settings, progress), delivery mode (start/exit, cargo abandonment penalty), settings (automatic route, detailed drop-off), list of the cargo containers of nearby vehicles and update of their weight in the vehicle VM. Also contributes to the big map POIs and to the delivery mode permissions.
usage:
if career_modules_delivery_general.isDeliveryModeActive() then
  local pen = career_modules_delivery_general.getDeliveryModePenalty()
  print('Money penalty if abandoned:', pen.money)
end
notes: Depends on core_vehicleBridge. The save format version (moduleVersion) is 42: an older save is ignored.
On load, if the save is more than one hour old (os.time), the parcels and generator timers of the facilities are cleared.
Delivery time (time()) advances by dtSim on each onUpdate unless setDeliveryTimePaused(true).
Abandonment penalty: money -= rewards.money * (0.1 + sum of the modifiers' abandonMultiplier), plus the organization's reputation and the vehicle tasks' fine; ignored for a parcel in transient move.
Detection radius for nearby vehicles: 25 m (comparison with the square 625).
'passenger' containers alone are ignored by getNearbyVehicleCargoContainers.
Probable bug: in defaultDelayCallback, step.startStepSequence(sequence, callback) uses 'callback', a variable not defined in this scope (nil).
The delivery modules are referenced in onCareerActivated; do not use them before.

getDeliveryAbandonPenaltyFactor.desc: Returns the base factor of the cargo abandonment penalty (0.1).

returns.desc: Factor applied to the money reward of the abandoned cargo.

loadSaveData.desc: Loads logisticsDatabase.json from the current profile (ignored if info.json is older than moduleVersion), initializes progress and parcelModProgress, settings (automaticRoute is true by default) and delivery time; clears the parcels if the save is more than one hour old.

onSaveCurrentProfile.desc: Save hook: writes logisticsDatabase.json (time, penalty, progress, non-expired parcels in facilities, non-expired vehicle offers, facility data, settings).

currentSavePath.desc: Folder of the profile being saved.

onCareerActive.desc: Hook: on career activation, loads the data, ensures the map (map.assureLoad) and launches dGenerator.setup.

onCareerActivated.desc: Hook: stores the other delivery modules (parcelManager, cargoScreen, generator, progress, vehicleTasks, tasklist, parcelMods, vehicleOfferManager, tutorial) and util_stepHandler.

time.desc: Current delivery time (cumulated simulation seconds, saved).

setDeliveryTimePaused.desc: Pauses or resumes the delivery clock.

getVehicleName.desc: Translated name of a vehicle via the career inventory, or a fallback label containing the id.

getNearbyVehicleCargoContainers.desc: Queries (asynchronous, 'getCargoContainers') the vehicles within 25 m of the player (excluding unicycle and unusable vehicles) and calls callback with the list, sorted (vehId then containerId), of the delivery containers: location, name, cargo types, total/used/transient/free slots, attachment status ('attached', 'nearby' or 'lost'), parcels present. Calls callback({}) if there is no vehicle.

getMostRecentCargoContainerData.desc: Last container list computed by getNearbyVehicleCargoContainers (refreshed about every second in onUpdate).

requestUpdateContainerWeights.desc: Schedules a container weight update; executed in onUpdate when the simulation is not paused.

updateContainerWeights.desc: If an update is scheduled, computes for each vehicle/container the volume (weight of parcels, volume of fluids and bulk) and the density, sends them to the vehicle (setCargoContainers), freezes the vehicle (setFreeze), reads the loading delay, then calls delayCallback with the delay per vehicle.

delayCallback.desc: Receives {[vehId] = delay in seconds}; by default shows a loading popup and unfreezes the vehicles.

onUpdate.desc: Per-frame hook: advances the delivery time, applies the penalty coming from a previous save (toast + addAttributes), refreshes the nearby containers every second and updates the weights.

onGetRawPoiListForLevel.desc: POI list hook: adds the visible (or targeted) delivery facilities with their interactive access points.

onActivityAcceptGatherData.desc: Hook: for a 'logisticsOffice' element, adds the activity prompt info (facility title, properties, 'inspect cargo' button).

onCheckPermission.desc: Hook: in delivery mode, if a requested tag is in the restricted activities table (e.g. mission interaction, towing to garage, vehicle purchase), adds a permission with a label explaining the penalty.

startDeliveryMode.desc: Enables delivery mode (no effect if already active), clears the POIs and fires the onDeliveryModeStarted hook.

exitDeliveryMode.desc: Leaves delivery mode: cancels the transient moves, deletes the cargos in vehicles (changeCargoLocation 'deleted'), applies the abandonment penalty (money/reputation, toast, sound), abandons the vehicle tasks, clears the big map focus, schedules the weight update, clears the tasklist and fires onDeliveryModeStopped.

checkExitDeliveryMode.desc: Leaves delivery mode if there is neither cargo in vehicles nor a vehicle task left.

isDeliveryModeActive.desc: Indicates whether delivery mode is active.

getDeliveryModePenalty.desc: Computes the penalty if the player abandons the cargos in vehicles: table of negative attributes (money and <organization>Reputation). Adds the vehicle tasks' fine unless onlyVehIdsAsKeys is provided.

onlyVehIdsAsKeys.desc: Limits the computation to the listed vehicles.

isAutomaticRouteEnabled.desc: Returns the 'automaticRoute' setting (automatic route to the next destination).

setAutomaticRoute.desc: Enables/disables the automatic route: when enabled, calls cargoScreen.setBestRoute; when disabled, clears the path of the ground markers and the big map. Notifies the UI (guihooks 'automaticRouteSet').

setDetailedDropOff.desc: Sets the detailedDropOff setting and notifies the UI (guihooks 'detailedDropOffSet').

onSetBigmapNavFocus.desc: Hook: a manual waypoint placed on the big map disables the automatic route in delivery mode.

setSetting.desc: Writes a delivery setting (saved in logisticsDatabase.json).

onPartShoppingStarted.desc: Hook: leaves delivery mode if parts shopping starts.

onCareerPaintingStarted.desc: Hook: leaves delivery mode if painting starts.

onCareerTuningStarted.desc: Hook: leaves delivery mode if tuning starts.

onTeleportedToGarage.desc: Hook: leaves delivery mode if the player is towed to the garage.

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook: leaves delivery mode when a mission starts (change == 'started').

onRepairInGarage.desc: Hook: a vehicle repaired at the garage: deletes its cargos (with penalty) and checks for leaving delivery mode.

onInventoryPreRemoveVehicleObject.desc: Hook: before the vehicle object is removed from the inventory, deletes its cargos (with penalty) and checks for leaving delivery mode.
